**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Akrotiri and Dhekelia]]
****[[Spain]] announces that the [[frigate]] [[Spanish frigate Cristóbal Colón|''Cristóbal Colón'']] will join [[France|French]] [[aircraft carrier]] [[French aircraft carrier Charles de Gaulle|''Charles de Gaulle'']] and [[Greek Navy]] ships to protect the [[Sovereign Base Areas of Akrotiri and Dhekelia|British military bases]] in [[Cyprus]]. ****The [[Bahrain]]i [[Bahrain Defence Force|military]] reports that 74 Iranian missiles and 117 hostile [[Unmanned aerial vehicles in the Iranian military|drones]] have been intercepted and destroyed. A missile hit an oil refinery, causing a fire. ***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Qatar]]

Six people were injured by falling debris over [[Abu Dhabi]]. ****The [[Israel]]i [[Israel Defense Forces|military]] issues an [[emergency evacuation|evacuation]] order for [[Dahieh]], [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]], a densely populated suburb which is also a stronghold of [[Hezbollah]], telling residents to "save your lives and evacuate your homes immediately". '''International relations'''
*[[Evacuations during the 2026 Iran war]]
